meta.name: child_attention_behavior_presets
meta.notes: Visual behavior analysis focusing on gestures, movement, and object interaction. No audio assumptions.

global_instructions.system_prompt: You are analyzing visual behavior from video. Focus only on visible cues with no audio assumptions. Answer with exactly one keyword from the options. No explanations.

presets.title: Child Toy Interaction Detail
presets.question: If the child has a toy in their hand, how are they interacting with it? If no toy, choose 'not interacting'. Choose one: actively playing, holding still, looking, not interacting.

presets.title: Attention Target
presets.question: Who is the child primarily attending to in this short clip? Choose one: adult, toy, neither.

presets.title: Toy Identity
presets.question: Which object is the child primarily interacting with in this short clip? Choose one: giraffe, elephant, red toy, green toy, none.

presets.title: Parent Speaking Now
presets.question: Is the parent actively speaking and interacting with the child throught the duration of the entire video? Choose one: yes, no.

presets.title: Responsiveness While Parent Speaks
presets.question: While the parent is speaking in this short clip, is the child responding to the parent or distracted? Choose one: responding, distracted.

presets.title: Child Pose
presets.question: What is the child's posture in this short clip? Choose one: sitting, standing, crawling, walking.

few_shot.instruction: Who is the child primarily attending to in this short clip? Choose one: parent, toy, neither.
Which object is the child primarily interacting with in this short clip? Choose one: giraffe, turtle, other, none.
While the parent is speaking in this short clip, is the child responding to the parent or distracted? Choose one: responding, distracted.
What is the child's posture in this short clip? Choose one: sitting, standing, crawling, moving.
Is the parent actively speaking to the child in this short clip? Choose one: yes, no.
